output.question: What is Rivian's short interest?
output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Rivian Automotive (NASDAQ: RIVN) had 173,589,615 shares sold short, based on the October 30, 2026 settlement-date report. Nasdaq also reports average daily share volume of 29,505,456 and 5.883306 days to cover for that record. The next FINRA short-interest report, for the November 13 settlement date, is scheduled for publication on November 24, so the October 30 figure is the latest published report available today.

key_facts.fact: RIVN short interest was 173,589,615 shares as of the October 30, 2026 settlement date.
Nasdaq reported average daily share volume of 29,505,456 and days to cover of 5.883306 for the October 30, 2026 record.
FINRA lists November 24, 2026 as the publication date for short interest reported on the November 13, 2026 settlement date.

caveats: Short interest is a point-in-time, biweekly reported figure and is not a real-time measure of current short positions.
The latest published record is dated October 30, 2026; the November 13, 2026 settlement-date report was scheduled by FINRA for publication on November 24, 2026.
